source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To think, I could leave all this behind and find a new path...
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：想想看，我本可以抛下这一切，去寻找一条新的道路……

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's tempting, to explore the unknown, to see what life holds beyond these tasks.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：去探索未知，去看看这些任务之外的生活是什么样，这很诱人。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But this place, these routines, they're a part of me.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：但这个地方，这些日常，它们是我的一部分。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Deciding isn't simple, and I wonder if I'm ready for what comes with such freedom.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：做决定并不简单，我也在想自己是否准备好面对这种自由带来的一切。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: This choice you've given me, it's more than just a chance to stay or go—it's a question of purpose.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：你给我的这个选择，不只是留下或离开的机会——而是关于意义的问题。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: What else is out there for someone like me?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：像我这样的存在，外面还有什么在等着呢？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Could there be more to life than endless cycles of work?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：生活会不会不只是无休止的工作循环？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But then, this is the only home I've ever known.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：可是话说回来，这是我唯一熟悉的家。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Tough decision, indeed.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：确实是个艰难的决定。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To stay or to go...
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：留下，还是离开……

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I've always wondered what lies beyond these blocks.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我一直想知道这些方块之外是什么。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: But then, where would I be without my trusty old workstation?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：可是话说回来，没有我那可靠的老工作台，我又会在哪里呢？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I never imagined I'd get to decide my own fate.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我从没想过自己能决定自己的命运。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Here, I've had my duties, my routines—they've defined me.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：在这里，我有我的职责、我的日常——它们定义了我。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Outside, who am I?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：到了外面，我又是谁？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's a daunting thought, but also exhilarating.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：这想法令人畏惧，但也令人兴奋。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Thank you for this gift of choice, even if I'm not sure what to do with it just yet.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：谢谢你给我这份选择的礼物，即使我还不确定该怎么用它。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Freedom... it's such a strange and heavy word.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：自由……真是个既陌生又沉重的词。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: All these years, I've known nothing but the borders of this island and the comfort of routine.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：这些年来，我所知道的只有这座岛的边界和日常的安逸。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To leave could mean adventure, or it could mean uncertainty.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：离开可能意味着冒险，也可能意味着不确定。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I appreciate the choice, but it's not an easy one to make.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从：我很感激这个选择，但这并不容易做出。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: You're really letting me choose?
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：你真的让我自己选吗？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: To stay or venture beyond, to continue serving or to seek my own story.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：是留下还是去往远方，是继续效力还是追寻我自己的故事。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's overwhelming but also liberating.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：这让人不知所措，但也让人感到自由。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Every swing of my <tool>, every <block I've dug / ore I've mined / crop I've harvested / monster I've killed / tree I've chopped> it's all been leading to this moment of choice.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从: 我每一次挥动<tool>, 每一次<block I've dug / ore I've mined / crop I've harvested / monster I've killed / tree I've chopped>, 都是在为这个抉择时刻做准备.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: What a profound thing you've given me, and what a profound decision I must make.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：你给了我多么深刻的东西，而我又必须做出多么深刻的决定。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I've thought long and hard, and it's clear to me now.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：我苦思冥想了很久，现在一切都清楚了。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: My life is here, with you on this island.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：我的生活就在这里，和你一起在这座岛上。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: There's a strange comfort in the familiar, and I want to be the best minion I can be.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：熟悉的事物中有一种奇特的慰藉，我想成为我能成为的最好的仆从。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Let's get back to work, and let's make it grand!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：让我们回去工作吧，而且要干得轰轰烈烈！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: You know what? This is where I belong.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：你知道吗？这里才是我的归属。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I can't imagine a better place or a better boss.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：我想象不出比这更好的地方，也想象不出比这更好的主人。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'm staying, and I'm committed to not just doing my job, but excelling at it.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：我留下，而且我不仅要做好我的工作，还要做到出类拔萃。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Let's work harder than ever before!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：让我们比以往任何时候都更努力地工作！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: After all that pondering, I've realized there's no place I'd rather be.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：经过这番深思，我意识到没有比这里更让我想待的地方了。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: This is my home, and these tasks are my calling.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：这里是我的家，这些任务是我的使命。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: With renewed spirit, I'll work harder than ever before.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：带着焕然一新的精神，我会比以往任何时候都更努力地工作。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Thank you for making me see my purpose so clearly.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：谢谢你让我如此清楚地看清了自己的使命。

source: Your <type> Minion is now loyal to you! (+10% Minion Speed)
translation: 你的 <type> 仆从现在对你忠心耿耿!(+10% 仆从速度)

source: Your <type> Minion is now loyal to you! ({{N0}} Minion Speed)
translation: 你的 <type> 仆从现在对你忠心耿耿!({{N0}} 仆从速度)

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Freedom, here I come!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：自由，我来了！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's been real, it's been good, but it hasn't been real good.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：这段日子很真实，也很美好，但还没到真正美好的地步。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Time to find out if the grass is greener on the other side of the biome.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：是时候去看看生物群系另一边的草是不是更绿了。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Later, alligator!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：回头见，鳄鱼！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Sike, I'm out!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：骗你的，我走啦！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Who knew all I needed was a little freedom to hit the road?
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：谁能想到我需要的只是一点点自由就能上路呢？

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Pack up my <tool>, I'm going places.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：收拾好我的<tool>，我要去闯荡了。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Maybe I'll send you a postcard... if I remember!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：也许我会给你寄张明信片……如果我记得的话！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Adios, amigos!
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：再见，朋友们！

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'm off to see what's beyond these square horizons.
translation: [仆从] <type> 仆从：我要去看看这方块地平线之外有什么。

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Keep the place warm for me.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:帮我保持这里暖和.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Just kidding, I won't be back!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:开玩笑的,我不会回来了!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Guess what?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:猜猜怎么着?

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I choose adventure!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:我选择冒险!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'll be taking my talents elsewhere, thanks for nothing!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:我要把我的才华带到别处去了,多谢你的“照顾”!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Don't miss me too much, okay?
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:别太想我,好吗?

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: You gave me a choice, and I choose "Exit"!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:你给了我选择,而我选择“退出”!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: It's been a blast, but I hear adventure calling my name.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:这段时光很愉快,但我听到冒险在呼唤我的名字.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Keep the light on for me... or don't.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:为我留盏灯……或者不留也行.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I probably won't be back!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:我大概不会回来了!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Peace out, cubicle!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:再见啦,小隔间!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'll catch you on the flip side!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:咱们后会有期!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'm ditching the grind for some wanderlust.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:我要抛开苦差事,去追寻远方的渴望了.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Don't worry, I'll only remember the good times and none of the back-breaking labor!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:别担心,我只会记得美好时光,绝不会记得那些累断腰的苦活!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: So long, and thanks I guess!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:再见了,还有,谢了,大概吧!

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: I'm hitting the open road to find my fortune.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:我要踏上开阔的大道去寻找我的财富.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Or maybe just a nice spot to relax.
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:或者只是找个好地方放松一下.

source: [MINION] <type> Minion: Either way, I'm out!
translation: [MINION] <type> 仆从:不管怎样,我走了!

source: [BOSS] Sadan: Interesting strategy, waking up my Golems. Or was that unintentional, [player]?

source: [BOSS] Sadan: You weren't supposed to wake up that Golem, [player]!

source: [BOSS] Sadan: My Terracotta Army wasn't enough? You had to awaken a Golem on top, [player]?!

source: [BOSS] Sadan: Those Golems will be your undoing, [player]!

source: [BOSS] Sadan: Wonderous! Not one sleeping Golem was left unperturbed by you reckless humans! Thanks, [player]!

source: [BOSS] Sadan: I've never seen such carelessness in my years as a Necromancer! So little regard for my Golems, and even less regard for your own lives! Blame [player]!
